data.content_ref: inline:The problem instance 1efe5742ed5b shares mechanism with SRC_003, SRC_004, and SRC_005 in that they all derive the same solution set {911, 1131, 5739, 8811} for n by analyzing the prime factorization of m = n + 2005 where d(m)=21; this relation is refuted if a value of n is discovered that satisfies d(n+2005)=21 and 1 <= n < 10000 but is not in that set.
